How lightweight is your Desktop Environment?

Not very. Lightweight desktop is a false economy. My DE is taking up 7% of my RAM and 0% of CPU. I'm on Cinnamon.

The weakest point in a computer-human system is the human. Optimize for that.

My browser on the other hand is taking up 4x as much memory and much more cpu with only 6 tabs open. Your browser is running on top of an absolutely thin shell no matter what you're doing that's not worth optimizing further.

If you are doing something other than browsing like crunching data that will be the new load and run nearly the same regardless. Lightweight desktops have a purpose but most of it is again for the human. The is some value in minimalism there. Worrying about the effect on the system is silly. Even with "older systems" I wouldn't worry about Cinnamon causing a performance issue until I was below 512MB cause at 512 I would still run it.

What's really great is people recomending esoteric DEs to new people like that's really going to help their experience because of all the placebo performance boosts the get out of a light DE.
